name: search_mail
summary: Search Mail.app's indexed content via Spotlight (subjects, senders, body text). See docs/issues/note-applescript-mail-search-deferred.md for known precision gaps (very new mail, recently-migrated archives, Junk/Spam, account-exact scoping).

params.name: query
params.description: Free-text term (subject, sender, or body). Must not begin with '-' (safety guard, else Spotlight treats it as an option).

name: list_inbox
summary: List the most recent messages in Mail.app's inbox (or a named mailbox): sender, subject, date received, and the message id you pass to read_message. Read-only. Drives Mail via AppleScript, so the first use may prompt to grant Automation access to Mail.

params.name: mailbox
params.description: Name of a specific mailbox to list (e.g. 'Sent', 'Archive'). Omit to list the unified Inbox.

params.name: limit
params.description: Max messages to return (default 20, hard cap 50).

name: read_message
summary: Read one email's full plain-text body (plus sender/subject/date) by its message id from list_inbox. Read-only. PRIVACY: this returns real personal mail content, so invoke it deliberately. Drives Mail via AppleScript; the first use may prompt to grant Automation access to Mail. A stale id (message since moved/deleted) can be slow: Mail falls back to scanning every mailbox before reporting it missing.

params.name: id
params.description: The message id from list_inbox. Located across the inbox and all account mailboxes.

name: send_mail
summary: Compose and SEND a real email via Mail.app. Irreversible: there is no undo for a sent email.

params.name: attachments
params.description: Path(s) of existing file(s) to attach (leading ~ ok). If you only know roughly where a file is (e.g. "in Downloads"), locate it with the filesystem tool first, then pass the resolved path here.
